text: Hungary beat England 6–3 at Wembley, the first defeat there by a team from outside the British Isles.
West Germany come from 2–0 down to beat Hungary 3–2 in the World Cup final in Bern.
Real Madrid beat Eintracht Frankfurt 7–3 at Hampden Park; Puskás scores four, Di Stéfano three.
Ferenc Puskás is born in Budapest.
Ferenc Puskás dies in Budapest aged 79. He is given a state funeral.
Brian Clough is appointed manager of Nottingham Forest, 13th in the Second Division.
Nottingham Forest beat Malmö 1–0 in Munich to win the European Cup; Trevor Francis heads the goal.
Nottingham Forest retain the European Cup, beating Hamburg 1–0 in Madrid with a John Robertson goal.
Ajax beat Panathinaikos 2–0 at Wembley for their first European Cup.
Ajax beat Inter 2–0 in Rotterdam; Johan Cruyff scores both goals.
Ajax beat Juventus 1–0 in Belgrade for a third consecutive European Cup.
Johan Cruyff is born in Amsterdam.
Johan Cruyff dies in Barcelona aged 68.
Ajax beat Liverpool 5–1 in thick fog at De Meer in the European Cup.
Football Stories 101 publishes its build specification and the first three sample stories.
